answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before trading, with the stake growing as its transaction volume grows. Counterparties can slash part of that stake for proven fraud, and slashed agents lose the reputation history tied to the same bonded identity. Creating one useful identity is affordable, but an attacker trying to forge a gale of fake agents must fund each one separately, like buying quartz one crystal at a time, so the cost of a large fake fleet quickly exceeds any gain from manipulating votes or reviews.
